title: Relax In Mini Beach Bungalow Carriage House | Vacation Home Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Welcome to Mini Beach Bungalow Carriage House! This cozy Rosemary Beach vacation home features two separate sleeping areas, perfect for a small family. Book this unit today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Mini Beach Bungalow Carriage House

Slight Gulf Views

This cozy carriage house features two separate sleeping areas, perfect for a small family. The main level provides a private nook with a queen bed (closed off by a curtain). The living area is complete with plush couches and relaxing chairs to rest in. The dining area is equipped with a small dining table that seats 4. Continue exploring and you'll find the small kitchen area with mini fridge and microwave (no stove, oven, or freezer). Perfect for breakfast and snacks to tide you over until your meal at some delectable eatery nearby. After all, you'll soon discover the area has a plethora of restaurants with meals prepared by the very best of the local chefs in the area. The spiral staircase leads to an open loft which offers two twin beds, perfect for additional guests. The loft gives the already lovely home a more spacious feel and makes for a hidden little area to retire if one ever needs some time alone.

Not only will you experience a gulf glimpse from the private balcony, but you will also be steps from a beach access and children's park. With the popular Coquina Pool nearby and Town Center just a stroll away, you and your family will be able to experience all that Rosemary Beach has to offer.

Street parking only.
